d: Sunreef Yachts is seeking an experienced Head of Marketing Operations to lead the day-to-day management of its international marketing operations and oversee the execution of global marketing initiatives.
The role involves managing multidisciplinary teams, coordinating marketing activities across international markets and ensuring the effective delivery of campaigns, communications and events.
q: li
8+ years of marketing experience, including leadership of multidisciplinary teams.
li
Proven experience managing international marketing operations, campaigns and events.
li
Background in luxury, automotive, hospitality, yachting or other premium industries preferred.
li
Strong organizational, project management and people leadership skills.
li
Experience managing budgets, agencies and cross-functional stakeholders.
li
Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
li
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage
r: li
Oversee the daily operations of the international marketing department, including Creative, Digital, PR and Events.
li
Manage the execution of marketing campaigns, yacht launches and international brand initiatives in line with the company's strategic direction.
li
Coordinate departmental workflows, project timelines, resources and deliverables.
li
Act as the primary operational marketing contact for Sales, Charter, international dealers and other internal stakeholders.
li
Oversee the planning and delivery of international boat shows, private events and brand experiences.
li
Manage team performance, development and accountability across marketing functions.
li
Oversee operational marketing budgets, external agencies and supplier relationships.
li
Ensure consistent brand standards, quality and timely delivery across all marketing activities.
x: Opportunity to work on innovative and sustainable projects
Exposure to international standards and advanced technologies

q: li
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, or related field. Master's degree is a plus.
li
4+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in the IT industry.
li
Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing strategies.
li
Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and techniques.
li
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
li
Ability to think strategically and analytically, with strong problem-solving skills.
li
Proficiency in marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and analytics platforms.
li
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
li
Team player with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
r: li
Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans aligned with company objectives, target audience, and market trends.
li
Create compelling content for various marketing channels including website, social media, email campaigns, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, and more.
li
Oversee digital marketing campaigns including SEO, SEM, PPC, social media advertising, and email marketing to increase brand visibility and drive traffic.
li
Implement lead generation strategies to acquire new customers and nurture existing leads through targeted marketing campaigns.
li
Maintain brand consistency across all marketing channels and collateral, ensuring adherence to brand guidelines.
li
Conduct market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and industry trends to inform marketing strategies and product development.
li
Analyze marketing data and metrics to track campaign performance, evaluate ROI, and make data-driven decisions to optimize marketing efforts.
li
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, product management, and customer support to align marketing efforts with business goals and provide support as needed.
li
Plan and coordinate marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, conferences, and workshops to engage with prospects and customers.
